name: Flowstate
author: keegan-sucks
description: A Pomodoro focus timer that blocks distracting sites, plays a shuffled Spotify soundtrack (incl. your Liked Songs) via spotify_player, and isolates Obsidian on its own workspace when you begin a session.

barWidget.description: Pomodoro focus timer with site blocking, Spotify, and Obsidian

schema.label: Focus effects
schema.description: Master switch: run the blocking / Spotify / Obsidian actions when a session starts. Turn off to use the timer on its own.

schema.label: Soundtrack 1 name
schema.description: Label for the first soundtrack button.

schema.label: Soundtrack 1 Spotify URI/URL
schema.description: Spotify playlist/album/artist link for the first soundtrack. Paste a share link or a spotify:playlist:… URI, or the keyword 'liked' for your Liked Songs.

schema.label: Soundtrack 2 name
schema.description: Label for the second soundtrack button.

schema.label: Soundtrack 2 Spotify URI/URL
schema.description: Spotify playlist/album/artist link for the second soundtrack.

schema.label: Soundtrack 3 name
schema.description: Label for the third soundtrack button.

schema.label: Soundtrack 3 Spotify URI/URL
schema.description: Spotify link, or the keyword 'liked' to play your Liked Songs (shuffled). Leave empty to hide this button.

schema.label: Active soundtrack
schema.description: Which soundtrack is selected (0, 1, or 2). Also switchable in the panel.

schema.label: Focus volume (%)
schema.description: Volume Spotify is set to during a session (0-100). Tunable via the panel slider; the pre-session volume is restored when the session ends.

schema.label: Always shuffle
schema.description: Shuffle the soundtrack when a session starts.

schema.label: Block distracting sites
schema.description: Add the enabled blocklist categories to /etc/hosts during a session. Requires the one-time blocker setup (scripts/install-blocker.sh).

schema.label: Block: Social media
schema.description: Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, TikTok, Reddit, etc.

schema.label: Block: Video streaming
schema.description: YouTube, Netflix, Twitch, etc.

schema.label: Block: Shopping
schema.description: Amazon, eBay, Etsy, AliExpress, etc.

schema.label: Block: News & forums
schema.description: News aggregators, Hacker News, Quora, major news sites, etc.

schema.label: Block: Adult
schema.description: Adult content sites.

schema.label: Extra blocked domains
schema.description: Additional comma- or newline-separated domains to block during a session.

schema.label: Open Spotify
schema.description: Launch spotify_player (if needed) and start the soundtrack when a session begins.

schema.label: Open Obsidian
schema.description: Launch/focus Obsidian on the focus workspace when a session begins.

schema.label: Obsidian alone on workspace
schema.description: Move every other window off the focus workspace (into a hidden 'parked' special workspace) so Obsidian is the only window there. Restored when the session ends.

schema.label: Focus (Obsidian) workspace
schema.description: Workspace to put Obsidian on and focus. 0 = whichever workspace is active when the session starts.

schema.label: Music workspace
schema.description: Workspace to open spotify_player on (silently, out of the way). 0 disables placement. Flowstate places the window with hyprctl — no Hyprland window rule required.

schema.label: Focus minutes
schema.description: Length of each Pomodoro focus phase.

schema.label: Short break minutes
schema.description: Length of the short break after each focus phase.

schema.label: Focus cycles
schema.description: Number of focus phases before the long break.

schema.label: Long break minutes
schema.description: Length of the long break after the final focus cycle.

schema.label: Pomodoro sounds
schema.description: Play a bell between phases and three bells when the cycle completes.
